clinical_intent: Design a brachytherapy treatment protocol for locally advanced cervical cancer (FIGO Stage IIB-IIIB) that integrates MRI-guided adaptive brachytherapy with concurrent cisplatin-based chemoradiation. Include the target volume definitions, dose constraints, fractionation scheme, concurrent chemotherapy schedule, imaging requirements, and plan evaluation criteria per GEC-ESTRO recommendations.
